ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, the left side is a curve graph of land price in the same area in different periods changing with distance from the city center, and land-price curves of different years are marked; the right side is a plane schematic diagram composed of roads and land-price contour lines, the roads are in a cross intersection, there are many approximately ring-shaped but road-influenced and curved equal-land-price lines around, and positions such as b and d are marked. Then reason: To judge whether land-price values are equal, one should see whether the two points are located on the same equal-land-price line or the same level of contour line. In the right figure, the position where d is located and b correspond to the same equal-land-price line level, therefore the land-price value of d should be equal to b.

raw_record.question_text:
The following figure is a land-price curve graph of the same area in a certain city of our country in different periods.

<image1>

If this city reflects the land-price change in the right figure, then the value of d should be equal to ____.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中左侧是同一地区不同时期地价随距离变化的曲线，右侧是道路与地价等值线构成的平面示意图，图中有标注点/位置 b、d。再推理：在右图中寻找 d 所在的地价线，并比较 b 所在的地价线；若二者落在同一条等地价线或同一级等值线，则其地价数值相同。因此填“与 b 相等”。
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中左侧是同一地区不同时期地价随距市中心距离变化的曲线图，标出了不同年份的地价曲线；右侧是道路与地价等值线构成的平面示意图，道路呈十字交叉，周围有多条近似环状但受道路影响而弯曲的等地价线，并标有 b、d 等位置。
再推理：判断地价数值是否相等，应看两点是否位于同一条等地价线或同一级等值线。右图中 d 所在位置与 b 对应的是同一等地价线级别，因此 d 的地价数值应与 b 相等。

再推理：判断地价数值是否相等，应看两点是否位于同一条等地价线或同一级等值线。右图中 d 所在位置与 b 对应的是同一等地价线级别，因此 d 的地价数值应与 b 相等。

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the right panel as a land-price contour/road diagram: identify the labeled positions b and d and note that they are on the same land-price line or same contour level; also observe that the left panel is a land-price curve for different years used only to contextualize the symbols.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：右图是城市道路与地价等值线图，地价等值线围绕中心及交通线呈圈层/局部起伏分布；左图是把这种空间变化投影为沿某方向距离变化的地价曲线。再推理：沿右图相应方向作一条剖面线，记录经过各地价等值线时的高低变化，并把这些高低点对应到左图曲线的标注值。d 对应的剖面高度与 b 所在的等值线等级一致，所以 d 的取值应判为与 b 相等。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：右图为城市道路与地价等值线示意图，可以看到地价等值线大体围绕城市中心呈圈层分布，同时沿东西、南北向道路附近出现局部凸起或变化；图例显示实线表示道路，另一类线表示地价。左图为同一地区不同时期的地价随空间位置变化的曲线，纵轴是地价，横向表示从市中心、市区、郊区到远郊的距离变化，曲线上标有 b、d 等位置。再推理：若左图反映右图的地价变化，应沿右图相应方向作剖面，把经过地价等值线时的高低变化对应到左图曲线。d 所对应的位置与 b 处于同一地价等值线等级，即二者表示的地价高度相同。因此 d 的取值应与 b 相等。

下图为我国某市同一地区不同时期地价曲线图。

<image1>

该城市若反映的是右图的地价变化，则 d 的取值应与____相等。
raw_record.final_cot:
First describe the image: In the figure, the left side is a curve graph of land price in the same area in different periods changing with distance from the city center, and land-price curves of different years are marked; the right side is a plane schematic diagram composed of roads and land-price contour lines, the roads are in a cross intersection, there are many approximately ring-shaped but road-influenced and curved equal-land-price lines around, and positions such as b and d are marked.
Then reason: To judge whether land-price values are equal, one should see whether the two points are located on the same equal-land-price line or the same level of contour line. In the right figure, the position where d is located and b correspond to the same equal-land-price line level, therefore the land-price value of d should be equal to b.
